events.title: 태어나다
events.description_en: He was born in 1994. His birthplace is not publicly documented.

events.title: 칭화대에서 컴퓨터과학을 공부하다
events.title_en: He studied computer science at Tsinghua University
events.description_en: He completed his bachelor's degree in computer science at Tsinghua University.

events.title: 스탠퍼드에서 박사 과정을 시작하다
events.title_en: He began his PhD at Stanford
events.description: 스탠퍼드 대학교 컴퓨터과학 박사 과정에 들어갔다.
events.description_en: He began a PhD program in computer science at Stanford University.

events.title: 스탠퍼드에서 박사 학위를 받다
events.title_en: He received his PhD from Stanford
events.description: 스탠퍼드 대학교에서 컴퓨터과학 박사 학위를 받고, 같은 해 오픈AI에 들어갔다.
events.description_en: He earned his PhD in computer science from Stanford University and joined OpenAI that same year.

events.title: 챗GPT와 GPT-4 개발에 참여하다
events.title_en: He worked on ChatGPT and GPT-4
events.description: 오픈AI 연구원으로 챗GPT 초기 버전과 GPT-4 개발에 참여했다.
events.description_en: As a researcher at OpenAI, he took part in developing the first version of ChatGPT and GPT-4.

events.title: 추론 모델 o1의 핵심 연구자가 되다
events.title_en: He became a core researcher on the o1 reasoning model
events.description: 오픈AI가 내놓은 첫 추론 모델 o1 개발에서 핵심 연구자로 참여했다.
events.description_en: He served as a core researcher on o1, OpenAI's first reasoning model.

events.title: 오픈AI를 떠나 메타로 옮기다
events.description: 오픈AI를 떠나 메타의 새 인공지능 조직으로 자리를 옮겼다.
events.description_en: He left OpenAI and moved to Meta's new artificial intelligence organization.

events.title: 메타 슈퍼인텔리전스랩 수석 과학자가 되다
events.title_en: He became chief scientist of Meta Superintelligence Labs
events.description: 메타가 새로 꾸린 슈퍼인텔리전스랩의 수석 과학자로 임명됐다. 마크 저커버그에게 직접 보고하는 자리다.
events.description_en: He was named chief scientist of Meta's newly formed Superintelligence Labs, reporting directly to Mark Zuckerberg.
